name: Exiles Reef
description: Shore dive from St Julian's Tower in Sliema: rocky ground with gullies and overhangs, then seagrass and sand from about 10 m, and a wall that leads down to 25 m. Plenty of fish, with cuttlefish and flounder on the sand and groupers along the wall; good for training and night dives. The Tug 2 wreck lies at about 20 m further out.
conditions: Best with southerly or south-westerly winds.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
